issue.body:
## Bug

Fixes #23293. 

Problem was that `styled-jsx-plugin-sass` was used instead of `@styled-jsx/plugin-sass` so it didn't work. 

You can refer to the issue that is linked for more info.

All styles that are added with `styled-jsx` do exist in View Page Source, which means that they are applied as they should be. One thing that might be a problem is that you are using 3 ways to style an app. `.css`, `.module.css` and `styled-jsx` so they might be overriding each-other when in production.

It does work on localhost but while in `dev` mode only.

You should try to make a new project and see if `styled-jsx` works well.

Also, you don't need to install `styled-jsx` package as it is shipped with `NextJS` by default.
